Name: Farmer Portraits - Seasonal Emotional Festivals
Author: revenantFun
Description:
[size=5][b]A simple, no-frills content pack addition to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11398]Farmer Portraits by Aedenthorn[/url]. Templates were already made available for switching your portrait seasonally, and having your portrait "react" to NPCs' emotions, but I wanted one that would do that and also allow for having special looks for festival days, just like NPCs do in [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits[/url]--after all, why should they get all the fun?
[/b][/size][size=4]
I saw some people on the Farmer Portraits page who were interested in being able to have festival outfits as well as everything else the available portrait templates already offered. There were other mods already on Nexus that did all that and more, but the "and more" was kind of the problem in my experience... If you, like me, want to keep it simple, this is for you.

There are five config options, and you can have them switched on or off in any combination:

[u]Seasonal Portraits[/u][/size]
Enables farmer portraits to change per season

[size=4][u]Winter Indoor Portraits[/u][/size]
Enables farmer portraits to change to an "indoor" version when inside (during Winter only)

[size=4][u]Festival Portraits[/u][/size]
Enables farmer portraits to change per festival

[size=4][u]Island Portraits[/u][/size]
Enables a unique set of farmer portraits while visiting Ginger Island.
These don't change seasonally. [i]~Island Time~[/i] is its own season, you know?

[size=4][u]Desert Portraits[/u][/size]
Enables a unique set of farmer portraits while visiting Calico Desert.
These don't change seasonally. The desert's always hot and sunny!
[size=5][u][b]
IMPORTANT UPDATE - 8 OCTOBER 2026
[/b][/u][/size][size=4]
The new 1.0.1 version of Aedenthorn's [i]Farmer Portraits[/i] mod has reintroduced the ability to customize your farmer's reactions to specific NPCs and specific emotions, meaning that [i]all features of the old Legacy Version of this content pack are now restored as of the newest upload, version 1.3.0[/i]![/size]

[size=4]The relevant instructions have also been restored to both the readme packaged inside the mod and the copy [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28933?tab=docs]posted here[/url].[/size]

[size=4]A "Legacy version" of the original version of this pack that is made to be used with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20713]Farmer Portraits for 1.6[/url] will remain available under Optional Files for those who are still running older versions of Stardew, but: [u]if you are up to date with the current game version, there is no longer any reason to continue using the Legacy version[/u]. Migrating your portraits and any customizations over to the main version is strongly recommended, as the main version will be the only one maintained going forward. 

[u]Differences in current functionality compared to the legacy version of this pack:[/u][/size]

[list]
[*][size=3][s]emotions can no longer be tailored to react uniquely to each NPC's individual emotion--that is, your farmer will always copy their conversation partner's reaction[/s]  [b]U[/b][b]nique reactions are once again available in the main mod version as of v1.3.0![/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=3]players can have multiple sets of portraits for different saves by appending their farmer's name to the end of each of the portraits inside the content pack.[/size][/*]
[/list]

-------------------------------------------------------------------------

[size=4]Besides [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11398]Farmer Portraits[/url], no other mods are required or integrated in any way. This is just a simple template, and is feature-complete for what I wanted it to do. Hopefully there's a few other people who want that too!

It's not required, but [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] will allow you to edit your preferences in-game. If you prefer, booting the game once will also generate a [i]config.json[/i] inside the mod folder that you can just manually customize yourself.

A readme is included in the files and also [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28933?tab=docs]posted here[/url] that will help you customize your portraits. Even more specific instructions are inside the files themselves.[/size]

[size=4][u]Important note for players who use translation mods or play the game in languages other than English:[/u][/size]
[size=3]In order for Festivals and Events portraits to display properly, you will have to rename each folder under [i][u]assets\festivals[/u][/i] to reflect whatever the festivals are called in your translation mod and/or your in-game language selection. The folders are named in English by default.[/size]

-------------------------------------------------------------------------

[size=4][u]Installation:[/u][/size]
- Extract .zip into the Mods folder located inside your Stardew Valley install. Done! Remember to install [b]outside[/b] of your existing [i]Farmer Portraits[/i] folder. You can only use one content pack for that mod at a time, so if you were previously using a different one, you will have to remove it from your Mods folder.

[size=4][u]Uninstallation:[/u][/size]
- Delete the [b][b][CP] Farmer Portraits - Seasonal Emotional Festivals[/b][/b] folder from your [i]Stardew Valley\Mods[/i] folder, making sure to make a backup copy of your custom portraits beforehand (if you haven't already.)
